name: Hoshikawa Hisui
source:
‘There’s no need to worry.
I’ll stay by your side until you’re used to this.’

Well-mannered and polite, he takes on the role of scolding the blunt [url=/c39082]Hayato[/url].
However, he also seems to dislike women. Because a special power awakened within him, he joined the Fukurou.

[From [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2015/10/11/the-scales-of-nil-admirari-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
